title: Change one line of code
description: A few lines of code in an editor card (syntax colours by prismjs). One value is struck out and the new one is typed in its place; the line is lit. For 'you only change this'.

props.code: 2-7 short lines of code (not checked against the script)
props.from: the value that changes (must be in code)
props.text: small caps label on the card (optional)
props.cues: {"focus": time the line lights up, "swap": time it changes}
